question: How do I open a savings account?
answer: You can open a savings account in the app under Accounts > Open New. Keep your PAN and Aadhaar ready; video KYC takes about 10 minutes.

question: What is the minimum balance for a savings account?
answer: The Regular savings account needs an average monthly balance of Rs 5000. The Zero Balance account has no minimum but limits ATM withdrawals to 4 per month.

question: How can I close my account?
answer: Raise a closure request in the app under Profile > Close Account. Any remaining balance is transferred to your linked bank account within 3 working days.

question: How do I download my account statement?
answer: Go to Accounts > Statements in the app and choose the date range. Statements are available as PDF for the last 5 years.

question: How do I add a nominee to my account?
answer: Open Profile > Nominee and add the nominee's name and relationship. You can change the nominee at any time.

question: What interest rate do savings accounts earn?
answer: Savings accounts earn 3.5% per year on balances up to Rs 1 lakh and 4% above that. Interest is credited quarterly.

question: Can I have a joint account?
answer: Yes. Joint accounts can be opened at any branch with both holders present for KYC. App-only joint accounts are not available yet.

question: How do I update my address?
answer: Update your address in Profile > Personal Details and upload a valid address proof. Changes are verified within 2 working days.

question: How do I block my debit card?
answer: Block your card instantly in the app under Cards > Block Card or call 1800-000-1111. A blocked card cannot be unblocked; a new card is issued.

question: My card was stolen. What should I do?
answer: Block the card immediately from the app or by calling 1800-000-1111 and then request a replacement card. Report any unauthorised transactions within 3 days.

question: How do I set or change my card PIN?
answer: Go to Cards > Set PIN in the app and verify with the OTP sent to your registered mobile number.

question: What is the daily ATM withdrawal limit?
answer: The default ATM limit is Rs 25000 per day. You can lower or raise it up to Rs 50000 in Cards > Limits.

question: Can I use my debit card abroad?
answer: Yes. Enable international usage in Cards > Settings before travelling. A 3.5% foreign currency markup applies.

question: Why was my card transaction declined?
answer: Common reasons are insufficient balance, a wrong PIN, international usage turned off, or the daily limit being reached. Check Cards > Limits in the app.

question: How do I apply for a credit card?
answer: Eligible customers see a pre-approved offer under Cards > Credit Card. Others can apply with their last 3 months of salary slips.

question: When is my credit card bill due?
answer: The bill is generated on the 5th of each month and payment is due by the 25th. Paying only the minimum due attracts interest.

question: What documents do I need for a personal loan?
answer: You need PAN, Aadhaar, the last 3 months of salary slips and 6 months of bank statements. Self-employed applicants also need 2 years of ITR.

question: What is the interest rate on personal loans?
answer: Personal loan rates start at 10.5% per year and depend on your credit score and income.

question: Can I repay my loan early?
answer: Yes. Part-prepayment is free after 6 EMIs. Full foreclosure has a 2% charge on the outstanding amount.

question: How is my EMI calculated?
answer: The EMI depends on the loan amount, interest rate and tenure. Use the EMI calculator in Loans > Calculator to see the exact amount.

question: What happens if I miss an EMI?
answer: A late fee of Rs 500 applies and the missed payment is reported to credit bureaus. Contact us before the due date if you expect difficulty paying.

question: Do you offer home loans?
answer: Yes. Home loans are available for up to 80% of the property value with tenure up to 30 years.

question: How long does loan approval take?
answer: Pre-approved personal loans are disbursed instantly. Other personal loans take 2 to 3 working days after documents are verified.

question: How can I check my loan balance?
answer: Your outstanding loan balance and EMI schedule are shown in Loans > My Loans.

question: I forgot my app password. How do I reset it?
answer: Tap Forgot Password on the login screen and verify with the OTP sent to your registered mobile number.

question: I am not receiving the OTP.
answer: Check that your registered mobile number is correct and has network coverage. Wait 2 minutes and tap Resend OTP. Do not share OTPs with anyone.

question: How do I change my registered mobile number?
answer: Mobile number changes need a visit to a branch with your ID proof for security reasons.

question: The app keeps crashing. What should I do?
answer: Update the app to the latest version and restart your phone. If it still crashes clear the app cache or reinstall it.

question: How do I enable fingerprint login?
answer: Go to Settings > Security > Biometric Login and confirm with your app password.

question: Can I use the app on two phones?
answer: No. For security the app can be active on one device at a time. Logging in on a new phone logs out the old one.

question: How do I set up UPI in the app?
answer: Open Payments > UPI and link your account. Create a 4 or 6 digit UPI PIN using your debit card details.

question: What is the daily UPI limit?
answer: The UPI limit is Rs 1 lakh per day. New users have a Rs 5000 limit for the first 24 hours.

question: How do I report a fraud transaction?
answer: Report fraud immediately in Help > Report Fraud or call 1800-000-1111. Reporting within 3 days limits your liability.

question: Someone called asking for my OTP. Is this the bank?
answer: No. The bank never asks for your OTP or PIN or password by phone or message or email. Do not share them and report the call in Help > Report Fraud.

question: How do I know if an SMS is really from the bank?
answer: Bank messages come only from sender ID SAHYDB. Never click links in messages from other senders.

question: How do I change my transaction password?
answer: Go to Settings > Security > Change Password and verify with OTP.

question: Is my money safe if the bank fails?
answer: Deposits are insured by DICGC up to Rs 5 lakh per depositor.

question: What should I do if my phone is lost?
answer: Call 1800-000-1111 to block app access and your cards. Then visit a branch to update your mobile number.

question: Can I open an account for my child?
answer: Yes. Minor accounts are available for children under 18 with a parent or guardian as the operator.

question: Is there an annual fee for the debit card?
answer: The Classic debit card is free. The Platinum debit card has an annual fee of Rs 499 waived above an average balance of Rs 50000.
